record.question: Which of the following statements are not correct: A woman married under muslim laws shall be entitled to obtain a decree for dissolution of he marriage on the following ground.
options: That the whereabouts of the husband have not been known for a period of 7 years.
That the husband has neglected or has failed to provide for her maintenance for a period of two years.
That the husband has been insane for a period of two years or is suffering form leprosy or a virulent vinereal disease.
record.explanation: PDF page 5 (Q42) shows the stem with a typo ('he marriage') and four options that are themselves grounds rather than combinations. Under the Dissolution of Muslim Marriages Act, 1939, the husband's absence ground requires four years, not seven, so option (a) is the incorrect statement; the other grounds (maintenance, insanity/leprosy) match the Act. Medium confidence because the stem is loosely phrased.
